purpose: Require dependence-aware pilot power evidence before GPU tranche 1; census-v4 variance is planning context only and can never authorize spend.

estimands.candidate_minus_P5: For each governed session, candidate neutral-lifecycle serial PnL dollars minus exact P5-under-cap neutral-lifecycle serial PnL dollars.
estimands.candidate_minus_matched_random: For each governed session, candidate neutral-lifecycle serial PnL dollars minus the frozen equal-weight aggregate of the eight valid matched-random schedules' neutral-lifecycle serial PnL dollars.
estimands.population: FT2-10 universal serial grid and separate policy-causal ledgers
estimands.lifecycle: hold successful t+1 entry fills to exact 15:55 forced flat
estimands.fees: Compute separately for the causal $3 and causal $4 trajectories.
forbidden_estimands: oracle minus P5 as actual campaign variance
marginal candidate PnL without a paired comparator

confidence_power_and_multiplicity.family_size: the exact pre-outcome ordered multiplicity ledger count from multiplicity_spec.json
confidence_power_and_multiplicity.planning_critical_value: z_(1-alpha/m)+z_0.80 for the one-sided Bonferroni planning approximation
confidence_power_and_multiplicity.final_inference: bootstrap_spec.json synchronized studentized maxT; the Bonferroni value is spend planning only

dependence_adjusted_MDE.input_series: paired neutral-lifecycle serial-dollar session deltas from training-side inner-fold pilot results
dependence_adjusted_MDE.marginal_session_SD: ordinary sample SD of the same paired session-delta series
dependence_adjusted_MDE.per_fold: Compute from that fold's paired series, SD, corrected ESS, and active family count.
dependence_adjusted_MDE.pooled: Use fold-specific LRV/n contributions under fixed fold weights; do not estimate dependence across folds and do not replace pooled ESS with raw session count.
dependence_adjusted_MDE.block_power_check: Also simulate power by shifting the measured pilot session-delta series by the stated bound and applying the frozen {3,5,8} bootstrap envelope with bootstrap_spec.json contiguous delete-L SE_h and replicate-specific SE_h_star. If analytic and simulated MDE disagree on the spend route, use the larger MDE.
dependence_adjusted_MDE.quality_DeltaQ: If reported for resource planning, repeat on the DeltaQ session series with its own SD and corrected ESS; it cannot substitute for the economic MDE.

serial_trade_count_projection.neutral_lifecycle_rule: A successful entry occupies the only position until 15:55, so no policy can execute more than one trade in a governed session.
serial_trade_count_projection.projection_rule: Report the pilot's session-level entry probability and projected count, clipped to [0,number_of_sessions]. Never multiply a multi-trade census rate by sessions.
serial_trade_count_projection.census_trade_rate_role: FT2-05 v4 guardrail trade rates are report-only multi-trade oracle diagnostics, are incompatible with the neutral one-trade component population, and are not a selection rule or trade-count projection.

census_v4_provenance.role: planning-only context; never a spend authorization and never candidate evidence

session_variance_components.interpretation: This v4 row is a hindsight best-entry-oracle minus P5 ceiling under the hold-to-forced-flat variant. It is not the candidate-minus-comparator pilot estimand and its variance cannot authorize spend.

minimum_detectable_improvement.role: v4 census planning table only; its raw-n session-cluster rows are not the FT2-11 pilot result

guardrail_trade_rates.role: diagnostic only and excluded from neutral-lifecycle trade projections

plausible_detectable_improvement_bound.basis: The exact FT2-05 v4 overall/all hold_to_forced_flat mean_session_increment row cited above.
plausible_detectable_improvement_bound.derivation: Use 100% of the existing hindsight neutral-lifecycle oracle-minus-P5 mean as an empirical planning ceiling; no unsupported fractional haircut or uplift is applied.
plausible_detectable_improvement_bound.why_defensible_for_spend_screen: P5 is the harder required comparator in the component game, and a learned candidate cannot be presumed to exceed the hindsight best-entry ceiling. This is deliberately generous and can block only when the pilot design cannot detect even that ceiling.
plausible_detectable_improvement_bound.FT2_21_owner_change: Any tighter, looser, or non-census bound requires an explicit owner-set FT2-21 amendment before results; it may not be chosen after pilot outcomes.

required_first: freeze and hash the candidate identities and ordered multiplicity ledger
run the exact FT2-10 serial state machine on inner-fold pilot predictions
measure paired candidate-minus-P5 and candidate-minus-matched-random session-delta series
measure statistic-specific marginal SD, Geyer ESS, and LRV
measure realized session entry rate and respect the one-trade-per-session cap
recompute analytic and block-power MDE for both comparators and both fee trajectories

all_required: checkpoint/resume dry-run proof cost is at most $10
actual ordered multiplicity ledger is frozen and hashed
pilot paired session-delta variance, LRV, ESS, and trade count are present for both comparators
larger of analytic and block-power MDE is at most $2,049.4222222222224/session for both required comparators on the $3 trajectory
$4 trajectory MDE is reported and does not contradict resource feasibility
all inputs are training-side pilot evidence or hash-cited census-v4 planning context

forbidden_stale_claims: any fractional haircut of a prior oracle ceiling
any prior-census session count or hash
any multi-trade-per-session projection for the neutral lifecycle
